if torch.cuda.is_available():
    for i in range(torch.cuda.device_count()):
        props = torch.cuda.get_device_properties(i)
        print(f'  GPU {i}: {torch.cuda.get_device_name(i)} ({props.total_memory // 1024**3}GB)')

print(f'transformers={transformers.__version__}')
print(f'peft={peft.__version__}')
print(f'accelerate={accelerate.__version__}')
print(f'datasets={datasets.__version__}')

print()
print('=== Model Check ===')
import os
for model in ['Qwen3-4B', 'Qwen3-8B']:
    path = f'/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache/Qwen/{model}'
    if os.path.isdir(path):
        safetensors = [f for f in os.listdir(path) if f.endswith('.safetensors')]
        total_size = sum(os.path.getsize(os.path.join(path, f)) for f in safetensors)
        print(f'{model}: {len(safetensors)} shards, {total_size / 1024**3:.1f}GB')
    else:
        print(f'{model}: NOT FOUND')

print()
print('=== Data Check ===')
data_dir = '/root/exec-sim-repair-verifier/data'
for f in sorted(os.listdir(data_dir)):
    fp = os.path.join(data_dir, f)
    if os.path.isfile(fp):
        print(f'  {f}: {os.path.getsize(fp)/1024:.0f}KB')
    else:
        print(f'  {f}/ (dir)')

print()
print('=== Scripts Check ===')
scripts = [f for f in os.listdir('/root/exec-sim-repair-verifier') if f.endswith('.py')]
print(f'{len(scripts)} Python files')

print()
print('=== Disk Usage ===')
"
